title: Long Term Follow-up Study of AAVAnc80-hOTOF Gene Therapy
official: An Evaluation of the Long Term Safety and Efficacy of AAVAnc80-hOTOF Gene Therapy in Individuals with Sensorineural Hearing Loss due to Otoferlin Gene (OTOF) Mutations
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long term safety of AAVAnc80-hOTOF, including late-occurring adverse events.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Individuals with OTOF-mediated hearing loss who received an intracochlear administration of AAVAnc80- hOTOF in the AK-OTOF-101 clinical trial (either Part A or Part B).
2. Legally authorized representative and/or participant willingness to comply with all study requirements, as evidenced by successful completion of the informed consent process or permission and participant assent process (where appropriate).
Exclusion criteria:
1. Any condition that would not allow the potential participant to complete follow-up examinations during the course of the study and/or, in the opinion of the Investigator, makes the potential participant unsuitable for the study. Potential participants will not be excluded based on their sex, gender, race, or ethnicity.

sites.f: Sant Joan De Deu Barcelona Hospital – Pediatric Otorhinolaryngology
